text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High-severity: serving runtime errors spiking for model-group 'redwood-v3' in eu-central. Error rate x6, clients seeing 502/500. Autoscaler churn detected. Paging on-call 2024503210

nina_ops: I'm taking the pager. immediate symptoms: crashloops on `redwood-v3` pods, kubelet logs show `Process killed: OOM` and node flaps on gpunode-eu-23/24.

omar_infra: Confirmed. Cluster-autoscaler logs show rapid add/remove of nodes (scale up -> 40 nodes, scale down -> 10 nodes within 90s). HPA oscillating between 5 and 45 replicas. Looks like scale-in/scale-out feedback loop.

liya_ml: We pushed a memory-optimized quantization variant ~15m ago to handle long-contexts. Bench memoria looked ok but we didn't test sustained load with long KV caches. Could be memory growth under real traffic.

ravi_sre: Immediate plan: 1) pause cluster-autoscaler scale-down, 2) pin HPA minReplicas to current stable count to avoid aggressive scale-down, 3) divert 40% traffic to stable-legacy route, 4) set `OOMScoreAdj` and pod memory requests increased as stopgap. tia_platform can you throttle traffic?

tia_platform: Applying traffic diversion: `trafficctl route set redwood-v3 stable=0.6,legacy=0.4` now. Deploy-bot: please confirm.

deploy-bot: trafficctl update accepted. Changes propagate ~25s.

omar_infra: Pausing scale-down: `kubectl patch deployment cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --patch '{"spec":{"strategy":{"type":"RollingUpdate"}}}'` (note: just a placeholder, using CA UI to disable scale-down). Disabled scale-down for 20m from control plane.

nina_ops: Pinned HPA: `kubectl patch hpa/redwood-v3 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":20}}'` and set `coolDownPeriodSec=300` (via autoscaler policy).

liya_ml: I will rollback the v3-quantized canary now. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-v3-canary`

support-bot: Alert: 3 customer incidents detected (FinServCo, MedSync, DocuWrite) reporting intermittent 500s, two on eu-central.

tia_platform: Also enabling traffic-level rate limiting for large batched requests: `ratelimitctl set redwood-v3 max_tokens_per_request=1024` to reduce KV-cache pressure.

omar_infra: Node-level observation: newly provisioned spot GPUs have slower startup which exacerbates cold-start memory allocation pattern -> some pods hit OOM during init. Cordon gpunode-eu-24 and drain suspect nodes.

nina_ops: Draining gpunode-eu-24: `kubectl drain gpunode-eu-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

liya_ml: After rollback + traffic shed we still see some OOMs but crashloops reduced. Applying env override to cap cache: `KV_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=268435456` on deployment.

ravi_sre: Also lowering HPA target from 70% -> 65% CPU to reduce sensitivity. `kubectl patch hpa/redwood-v3 -p '{"spec":{"targetCPUUtilizationPercentage":65}}'`

tia_platform: Traffic shift + rate limits live. 5xx rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2% over last 5 minutes. Latency tail improving.

support-bot: Notified customers: "We're mitigating a capacity thrash causing transient errors; throttling large requests and rolling back a canary. We'll update in 30m."

omar_infra: Observed autoscaler metrics: eviction spikes subsided. Current node count stabilizing around 22. No new node flaps in last 6m.

nina_ops: Key commands run during mitigation:
```
trafficctl route set redwood-v3 stable=0.6,legacy=0.4
kubectl patch hpa/redwood-v3 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":20,"targetCPUUtilizationPercentage":65}}'
kubectl cordon gpunode-eu-24
kubectl drain gpunode-eu-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-v3-canary
kubectl set env deploy/redwood-v3 KV_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=268435456 --overwrite
# pause CA via cloud console (scale-down disabled)
```

liya_ml: Recording for RCA: quantized variant increases peak KV cache transiently for long-token sessions. Need to add long-session soak tests + pre-rollout mem profiling.

ravi_sre: Post-incident actions: - immediate runbook update for autoscaler cooldowns on serving groups - add HPA hysteresis defaults for model deployments - validate node startup timings for spot GPU pools.

tia_platform: Creating postmortem ticket INC-2024503210 and assigning infra+ml+sre. Link: https://redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2024503210

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated by nina_ops. Status -> stabilizing. Will auto-close when RCA posted. Mitigated at 2024503899.

nina_ops: Handoff: I'll leave the thread to ravi_sre for RCA ownership. Ravi, summary: canary rollback, traffic diversion, KV cap, CA scale-down paused, drained a flaky node, HPA pinned. Attach logs from gpunode-eu-23/24 and autoscaler events.

ravi_sre: Acknowledge handoff. I'll prepare timeline and RCA. Thanks everyone. Keep saved logs & any flamegraphs.

support-bot: Closing loop: customers updated. We'll send follow-up once RCA done.

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident status: mitigated -> create RCA within 72h. Thread closed 2024503899."
